vetSays.line: 🛡️ Hudson, Ray, the woman in her 40s, with a gap-toothed grin, Nino and Owen met them at the door — 5 put down. Hudson, Ray, the woman in her 40s, with a gap-toothed grin, Nino, Owen are hurt.
🛡️ Kwame, Hudson, Ray, Haruto and Petra met them at the door — 5 put down. Kwame, Hudson, Ray, Haruto, Petra are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Oliver just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Haruto just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ray, Haruto and Petra met them at the door — 3 put down. Ray, Haruto are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Oliver just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
🛡️ Ella and Raul met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Ella, Raul are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Maya just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ella just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ella, Kai and Meshari met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Kai, Meshari are hurt.

regDeaths.name: a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong
a soft green glow under the water
a toad like a war drum, throat swelling
a line of ducks, walking in perfect formation. In the dark. That is not normal duck behavior.
two knobs on glass-still water, watching
a heron that isn't quite there when you look at it
a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something
a dog-shaped silence at the treeline
the absence of sound, shaped like wings
